registrationDatum: Actual physical ground-plane vertices, not alpha bottom. Back vertex inferred from parallel axes where occluded. Each cell is uniformly calibrated by footprint tier then translated to normalized ground centre (128,192).
limitations: Generated painted source is approximately 2:1; some foreground slopes are close to 0.60 rather than exact 0.50. No vertical compression or per-silhouette fit was applied.
Shop door headers are partly hidden by awnings; outer frame measurements have ±3 source-pixel uncertainty.
Ballpark has no observable ordinary personnel doorway; its full inset field/garden was measured and uniformly calibrated to 28m square.

Shared filtering-clearance reductions apply to complete footprint tiers. Observed personnel frames render at1.72–1.98m and the ballpark field at26.04m; original calibration targets remain in the packing metadata.
groundDatumMethod: Midpoint of observed opposite right/left ground vertices. Hidden back vertices remain uncertain inference and do not affect registration. No silhouette/alpha-bottom datum.
